I went to school for a few years so I can read prices and do sums, but this bean plot is only 0.06 hectares and I must be careful with every shilling. I will not buy chemical fertilizer because one bag costs too much and would be too much for this small piece anyway; instead I will carry manure from my homestead and put it there because I own this land and I want to keep the soil good. I am using the bean seed I saved from last season — it is free and I know it grows well here. My children and I will do all the work ourselves, about twelve days over the season for planting, weeding twice, and harvesting, and we will not hire anyone.
